subject: Field study for Medical Park Family Care on your morning phone peak
body:
Your FAQ tells patients the phones peak before 10 every morning especially Mondays and to try again after 11. That hour is the one your front desk can least afford. We already did the study on that and the first thing we'd build has no AI in it.

https://alaskaaihq.com/awesomeproposal/medical-park-family-care/

Tell us if it's useful.

Talon at Alaska AI
title_note: Their site publishes no administrator or executive title. Do not give anyone one.
opens_on: Their published FAQ line, 'Our peak calling time is between 8:30am-10am every morning, especially Mondays,' followed by their own instruction to use the portal or call after 11.
lead_critic: ship after one fix, round 2. Cut the sentence grading their own fix, replaced with what the hour costs them. 'Your own FAQ' softened to 'Your FAQ'.
